name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: PMAY-U is an urban housing scheme of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs that supports the Housing for All objective for eligible urban households.
benefits: The programme supports affordable housing through applicable components and current guidelines. The kind and amount of assistance depend on the relevant component, location, and approved application.
eligibility: Official scheme information lists income categories and housing conditions among its checks. Applicants and family members generally must meet the current scheme conditions, including the applicable no-pucca-house and location requirements. Authorities make the final determination.
documents: The official application process may require identity, residence, income, bank, and housing-related documents. Confirm the current requirements on the official PMAY-U portal before applying.
application_process: Use the official PMAY-U portal and select the current application option. Read the applicable eligibility criteria before submitting information or Aadhaar-authentication consent.

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Urban poor and middle-income families (EWS, LIG, MIG) seeking affordable housing
